entries.reason: The flaw is in deserializeErrors(), used only to hydrate server-rendered (SSR) data. web is a client-side SPA with no SSR and no hydration data. No fix in react-router 6.x.
Open redirect when an attacker controls the path given to <Link> or useNavigate. web only passes constant, in-app paths to them. No fix in react-router 6.x.
